It grossed over $92.4 million worldwide upon release,[92] but most critics, and the studio heads, disliked the film.[91] Writing for the *Los Angeles Times*, Charles Champlin described *1941* as "the most conspicuous waste since the last major oil spill, which it somewhat resembles".*[93]* Another critic wrote "*1941* isn't simply a silly slur against any particular race, sex, or generation—it makes war against all humanity."*[93]*
